name: LCM distilled table (ModelSamplingDiscrete lcm)
plain: Selecting lcm in ModelSamplingDiscrete replaces the table with 50 entries at a stride of T/50 and changes the denoised formula, so schedulers now walk a shorter table. The prediction mix is a consistency-style skip and output.
math:
Keep every (T//50)th sigma from the top. timestep = argmin index·skip + skip−1.
x0 = x − ε·σ; t' = 10t; c_skip = 0.25/(t'²+0.25); c_out = t'/√(t'²+0.25); denoised = c_out·x0 + c_skip·x.
